evidence.quote: Looking forward, however, I expect tariffs will put upward pressure on inflation.
At the same time, tariffs may cause the economy to slow and unemployment to rise.
Monetary policy is well positioned to allow us to wait and see how economic conditions unfold.
The economy is currently on a sound footing, with low and steady unemployment, and disinflation having continued at a gradual, albeit uneven, pace toward our 2 percent target.
